verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover each part of the story. Events API integrations deduplicate alerts that share a `dedup_key`, and Event Orchestration can deduplicate or suppress alerts. Intelligent Alert Grouping uses ML to consolidate related alerts into a single incident, AIOps claims 91% alert reduction, and escalation policies notify a single target at a time until someone acknowledges, so one incident pages one human. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that dedup and grouping actually reduce pages in practice.
